title: Resume Bullet Formula That Gets You Interviews (Most People Miss This)
description:
If you’re qualified but not getting interviews, your resume bullet points might be the problem.

Most resumes don’t get ignored because of experience—they get skipped because bullet points read like job descriptions instead of proof of impact.

In this video, I break down a simple resume bullet formula (ATV: Action • Task • Value) to help you turn responsibilities into results and show hiring managers exactly why you belong in the interview pile.

You’ll learn:
• Why resume bullet points get ignored
• The ATV method for stronger, results-driven bullets
• How to show impact—even without perfect metrics
• Real before-and-after resume examples

This is Part 3 of my Get Seen series—focused on helping you write a resume that actually gets noticed.
